systems.name: General
systems.summary: An all-round rubric for most sit-down meals. Food carries half the score; service, value and atmosphere share the rest. Judge the restaurant against what it sets out to be.

criteria.name: Food
criteria.guidance: Flavour, cooking, ingredients and consistency across everything you ordered.

levels.label: Inedible
levels.detail: Dishes were left unfinished or sent back. Something was unsafe, spoiled or badly wrong.

levels.label: Poor
levels.detail: Most dishes had clear flaws: bland, greasy, over- or under-cooked. You would not order any of it again.

levels.label: Uneven
levels.detail: One or two things were fine, but the meal as a whole was forgettable or inconsistent.

levels.label: Good
levels.detail: Solid, enjoyable cooking with no real mistakes. You left satisfied, though nothing stood out.

levels.label: Very good
levels.detail: Well-made food with at least one dish you would come back for specifically.

levels.label: Exceptional
levels.detail: Memorable from start to finish. Every dish was excellent and several were among the best of their kind you have had.

criteria.name: Service
criteria.guidance: How you were treated, in the style the restaurant offers. Counter service done well can score full marks.

levels.label: Let you down
levels.detail: Rude, absent or disorganised. Service made the visit worse.

levels.label: Fine
levels.detail: Polite and functional, with small lapses such as slow check-ins or a forgotten request.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.detail: Warm, attentive and well paced. Staff knew the menu and you never had to chase anything.

criteria.name: Value
criteria.guidance: What you got for what you paid. An expensive meal can be full value and a cheap one can be poor value.

levels.label: Overpriced
levels.detail: The bill felt out of line with the quality or portions. You would not pay this again.

levels.label: Fair
levels.detail: About what you expected to pay for a meal of this quality.

levels.label: Great value
levels.detail: The quality and care clearly exceeded the price, whatever that price was.

criteria.name: Atmosphere
criteria.guidance: Whether the room suits the kind of place it is. Simple decor is not a fault; discomfort, dirt or noise that spoils the meal is.

levels.label: Detracted
levels.detail: The space got in the way: uncomfortable, unclean, or too loud to enjoy the meal.

levels.label: Fits the place
levels.detail: Comfortable and clean, with a setting that suits the restaurant's style and added to the visit.

systems.name: Fine Dining
systems.summary: For tasting menus and special-occasion restaurants, where service and setting are part of what you pay for. A high price is expected here and does not lower the score on its own.

criteria.name: Food
criteria.guidance: Technique, ingredients, originality and how well the menu holds together as a whole.

levels.label: Failed
levels.detail: Serious technical faults or dishes that simply did not work. Well below what the format promises.

levels.label: Below the bar
levels.detail: Competent in places but with several weak or muddled courses for a restaurant at this level.

levels.label: Accomplished
levels.detail: Skilled, polished cooking with good ingredients, but few surprises and a course or two that fell flat.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.detail: Precise and distinctive cooking. Nearly every course landed and a couple were outstanding.

levels.label: Extraordinary
levels.detail: A complete, original menu with no weak course. Food you will remember and describe to people for years.

criteria.name: Service
criteria.guidance: Pacing, knowledge, anticipation and how at ease the team made you feel.

levels.label: Poor
levels.detail: Inattentive, stiff or careless. Long unexplained waits or mistakes that were not put right.

levels.label: Adequate
levels.detail: Correct but impersonal or uneven. Courses were paced awkwardly or questions went unanswered.

levels.label: Polished
levels.detail: Knowledgeable and well paced, with only minor slips. You felt looked after.

levels.label: Seamless
levels.detail: Anticipated what you needed before you asked. Warm, exact and unobtrusive from arrival to goodbye.

criteria.name: Atmosphere
criteria.guidance: The room, table, sound, lighting and sense of occasion.

levels.label: Undermined the meal
levels.detail: Cramped, noisy, tired or uncomfortable in a way that worked against the experience.

levels.label: Pleasant
levels.detail: A comfortable, well-kept room that did its job without adding much.

levels.label: Transporting
levels.detail: A considered space where the design, comfort and mood made the evening feel like an occasion.

criteria.name: Value
criteria.guidance: Whether the whole experience justified the bill at this level. Being expensive is not the test.

levels.label: Not worth it
levels.detail: The experience did not justify the price, even by fine-dining standards.

levels.label: Worth it
levels.detail: You would pay this again for the same experience.

systems.name: Fast Casual
systems.summary: For counters, trucks, slice shops and takeaway. Rewards great food at a fair price, served quickly and correctly. Decor and table service are not scored.

criteria.name: Food
criteria.guidance: Flavour, freshness and how well it is made for what it is. A perfect taco can score as high as any plated dish.

levels.label: Inedible
levels.detail: Stale, cold or wrong enough that you did not finish it.

levels.label: Poor
levels.detail: Low-quality ingredients or careless cooking. Not worth the calories.

levels.label: Passable
levels.detail: Filled a gap. Nothing wrong enough to complain about, nothing good enough to return for.

levels.label: Good
levels.detail: Fresh, tasty and reliably made. A dependable choice when you are nearby.

levels.label: Very good
levels.detail: Clearly better than most places of its kind. Worth a detour.

levels.label: Best in class
levels.detail: Among the best versions of this food you have eaten anywhere. Worth a special trip.

criteria.name: Value
criteria.guidance: Portion and quality for the price, compared with similar quick places.

levels.label: Rip-off
levels.detail: Small portions or poor quality for a price well above comparable places.

levels.label: Pricey
levels.detail: A little more than it should cost for what you get.

levels.label: Fair
levels.detail: A reasonable price for a filling, decent meal.

levels.label: A bargain
levels.detail: Generous and high quality for the money. You would happily pay more.

criteria.name: Speed and Accuracy
criteria.guidance: How long you waited relative to how busy it was, and whether the order was right.

levels.label: Slow or wrong
levels.detail: A long wait with no explanation, or the order was wrong and not fixed.

levels.label: Acceptable
levels.detail: A reasonable wait, or a small mistake that was corrected without fuss.

levels.label: Fast and right
levels.detail: Quick for how busy it was, and everything was exactly as ordered.
